title: OFARM TemporalCoordinate v0.1 (candidate)
$comment: NEW_CANDIDATE package-local contract implementing ADR 0002 temporal meanings. Candidate per Constitution RC2.1 section 6.16; not active law, not a promoted machine contract, and not admitted to the production RuntimeBundle or any ActiveArtifactSet.

canonicalUtcInstant.$comment: Durable UTC instant. Semantic validation also proves the Gregorian date is real and never rounds or truncates excess precision.

validInterval.$comment: Half-open [validFrom, validUntil). When validUntil is present, semantic validation requires validFrom < validUntil.

windowValidCut.$comment: Half-open [windowStart, windowEnd). Semantic validation requires windowStart < windowEnd.

knowledgeCut.$comment: Tenant-scoped knowledge boundary. Position zero is the state before the first committed governed batch; positive positions order complete committed batches for this tenant only.

tenantId.$comment: Exact canonical, non-nil UUID installed by trusted TenantBinding.

windowMeaning.$comment: Required per temporal selection step by a future carrier contract; never one hidden query-wide convention.
